---
title: "Welcome"
---


I am a Reader in Probability and a member of the 
<a href="http://www.bath.ac.uk/research/centres/probability-laboratory/">Probability laboratory at Bath</a> in the 
<a href="http://www.bath.ac.uk/math-sci/">Department of Mathematical Sciences</a> at the 
<a href="http://www.bath.ac.uk/">University of Bath</a>.

I am currently member of the executive team of the [EPSRC CDT SAMBa](https://samba.ac.uk/).
I am also PI of the EPSRC project "Interplay between geometry and randomness in fitness landscapes for expanding populations"
    (with CoI <a href="https://mattiroberts.github.io/">Matt Roberts</a>).
